ConversationReconcile.title: ConversationReconcile
ConversationReconcile.description: Optional revision fence for a reconcile scan; omitted means scan without writing.

ConversationReply.title: ConversationReply
ConversationReply.description: Answer recorded by the request's addressee, sent through existing reply validation.

ConversationRequestCreate.title: ConversationRequestCreate
ConversationRequestCreate.description: Tracked request/reply workflow. The message itself uses the existing send validation.

LeaseRenewal.title: LeaseRenewal
LeaseRenewal.description: Fenced request to extend one live delivery lease. It never starts a new attempt.

ReportedTest.title: ReportedTest
ReportedTest.description: Producer-reported test outcome. Never treated as objective proof.

TaskDispatch.title: TaskDispatch
TaskDispatch.description: Worker contract: the caller claims work for one of its own live runs.

TaskDispatchOutcome.title: TaskDispatchOutcome
TaskDispatchOutcome.description: Agent self-report of how a dispatched attempt ended; never treated as verification.

TaskReconcile.title: TaskReconcile
TaskReconcile.description: Explicit recovery for terminal or stale scheduling state; never automatic.
